message:
The other day, we had a surprise storm roll in. As I watched the wind whip around the trees, I realized I was thankful for our little stash of board games. You know, the ones that have been gathering dust since the grandkids discovered tablets? 

As the rain pelted the windows, we spent the evening playing a raucous game of Monopoly, with plenty of laughter and a few friendly arguments over who gets to be the thimble. 

It was a wonderful reminder that sometimes, the best way to weather a storm is to rediscover some good old-fashioned fun. What’s your favorite low-tech activity to pass the time when the weather gets wild? 🎲
